cards.title: Their Space
cards.body: When they say 'I need some space,' the first thought often isn't 'Okay, cool.' It's 'Oh no, what did I do?' or 'Are they pulling away?' But usually, that space isn't about running from *you*. It's about finding their way back to *themselves*. It's a healthy pause to recharge, process, or just breathe, so they can return to the connection more present and whole. What if we saw their need for breathing room as self-care, not rejection, and openly talked about what that truly looks like for each of you?
cards.caption:
That gut feeling when your person needs some air... it can be a tough one to navigate. How do you both communicate your needs for closeness and distance?

video_reels.title: Clear Care
video_reels.line: Naming the exact feeling, even when it’s uncomfortable, isn’t conflict – it's an invitation to understand. It’s saying 'I care enough about us to be clear'.
video_reels.caption:
